prompt: Review these screenshots of an original C64 platform shooter called DEEP SIGNAL. The player is an orange astronaut, drones are red/purple, world platforms cyan/blue, HUD plates at the two top corners. Describe each image, legibility, sprite/terrain alignment, obvious corruption and composition. If any visual detail is uncertain say so. Do not infer frame rate or movement from still images. Be concise.

message.content:
Here is a description of each screenshot:

**Image 1:**
*   **Description:** A text-heavy screen displaying the title "DEEP SIGNAL" and several lines of white text providing mission objectives/status.
*   **Legibility:** High. The white text is clear against the black background.
*   **Sprite/Terrain Alignment:** Not applicable (text screen).
*   **Obvious Corruption:** None visible.
*   **Composition:** Centered text, typical of a title or menu screen.

**Image 2:**
*   **Description:** A side-scrolling action scene. An orange astronaut sprite is positioned on a cyan/blue platform. Red/purple drone sprites are visible in the background/mid-ground. The screen is framed by cyan/blue world platforms. HUD elements are visible in the top corners.
*   **Legibility:** Moderate. The sprites are discernible, but the resolution is low.
*   **Sprite/Terrain Alignment:** The astronaut appears correctly placed on the platform. The drones are positioned within the environment.
*   **Obvious Corruption:** None immediately apparent, though the pixel art style is very blocky.
*   **Composition:** Action-oriented, utilizing the full width of the screen to show gameplay.

**Image 3:**
*   **Description:** Another text screen, displaying "DEEP SIGNAL" and status updates ("SIGNAL RESTORED," "MISSION COMPLETE," etc.).
*   **Legibility:** High. The white text is clear against the black background.
*   **Sprite/Terrain Alignment:** Not applicable (text screen).
*   **Obvious Corruption:** None visible.
*   **Composition:** Centered text, typical of a status or end-of-level screen.
